Paper II has its kernel figures and a pass-1 hits-vs-waveforms headline. The two figures it is built around, the ladder compression and the tier benchmark, do not exist on pass 1

Every figure and metric found in the repo that could serve the reconstruction paper, sorted into paper sections, with what is paper-ready, what needs a remake, and what has never been made.

1

Details

Built by papers/paper2/make_collection_deck.py from papers/paper2/collection/index.json. Outline and plan: papers/paper2/OUTLINE_PLAN_2026-11-05.md. Three catalogue sweeps (waveform-first and June QA; wft, SPS and kernel; rerun and published notes) fed the list; ratings are mine, from reading the producer and, for most, looking at the image.

The paper in one line: hit times cannot be fixed by a better estimator, a forward model can fix them

Section order of the proposed paper; hover the boxes for the numbers; figures are in the slides that follow

Kernel

how charge reaches the neighbours

→

Hits fail

ladder compressed 20–30 %

→

Forward model

template × kernel × drift

→

Floor

0.30–0.35° diffusion

→

Hits vs waveforms

same events, tiers H0…W

→

Readout

threshold, neighbours

→

Known angle

det4 at 25.4°

The claim

A per-strip hit time mixes the strip’s own charge with delayed copies of its neighbours’. That compresses the drift ladder whatever the estimator.

The result

Same events, five chambers: angle s68 2.0–2.6° (hits) against 0.73–1.56° (waveforms).

The open question

How much of that gap a sharing-aware fit on hit lists recovers (H2c), and what a hit front-end must record.

10

Details

Closed form σθ ≈ D_T√(6(1+f)/(N·G)) gives 0.29° on det3. 60 ns depth bins bias steep tracks shallow (−0.08/−0.23/−0.51° at 25/30/40°); 20 ns bins are flat to 45°. Every measured imperfection together reaches 31–46 % of the measured resolution. Pass-1 remainder: 0.56–0.65° on det2/3/7 X. The July claim of 0.02° electronics plus ~1° centroid jitter was withdrawn on 2026-10-27.

What this does not settle · decisions

Six decisions, and what the collection cannot tell us

  • H2c in scope? The one new-result item and the largest piece of work.
  • Merge 7→6 and 8→9 for NIM A length?
  • Headline chambers: all five, or the calibration-row subset of fleet.pdf?
  • Floor: report the 0.30–0.35° diffusion floor and the 3–6× gap in Paper II, or keep it in Paper I?
  • 60 ns depth-bin bias (−0.5° at 40°): a paragraph, given n_TOF steep tracks?
  • Mount angle: 25.4, 25.6 or 25.64° in the text?
  • Whether the ladder compression holds on the other four chambers: only det3 has it, from July.
  • Whether a sharing-aware fit on hits (H2c) closes the gap. Not run.
  • Anything about a VMM front-end beyond emulation.
  • The ratings are mine: I opened about a third of the images; the rest I judged from the producer and its notes.
